summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Terms & Conditions and Privacy Policy integration for Network Capital (Mici (Pty) Ltd). All 15 features tested and working correctly. Sign Up form shows consent checkbox with clickable links, Legal Documents page has full T&C (14 sections) and Privacy Policy (11 sections), backend stores compliance data (terms_accepted, terms_accepted_at, terms_version).

issues: 'Made with Emergent' badge at bottom - requires force=True for button clicks (known issue from previous iteration)

test_credentials.note: No pre-seeded accounts. Tests create new users dynamically.
test_credentials.test_pattern: email: test_terms_<uuid>@example.com, password: Test123!, username: testterms_<uuid>

seed_data_creation: None - tests create their own test data
context_for_next_testing_agent: Terms & Conditions and Privacy Policy features fully tested and working. Key features: 1) AuthPage Sign Up form has consent checkbox (unchecked by default), clickable Terms & Conditions and Privacy Policy links, 'Create Account' button disabled until checkbox checked. 2) LegalDocumentsPage at /legal with tabs for Terms (14 sections) and Privacy Policy (11 sections), expandable sections, back button returns to previous page. 3) Backend stores terms_accepted (bool), terms_accepted_at (ISO timestamp), terms_version ('2025-01') in user document. 4) Login flow does NOT require terms checkbox. 5) Legal page accessible both when logged out (/legal route in auth section) and when logged in (via direct navigation).
